title: Q140(b) blind pool 7
written_by: an independent designer who never saw M9 (Q140(m)'s fit) or Q140(l)'s aifoundry2 terms, their data directories or their scratch, and corrected before the commit by its fix pass under the same rule (corrected_before_commit)
answers: kinds page section 11, items 6 and 7 (#11-what-is-still-open); Q139's final critic, ranks 1, 4 and 9
format: 2,048 bytes a tile: raw A (1,024 B) then raw B (1,024 B), in the type's layout (make_kinds.encode); stats from make_kinds.tile_stats; bus_by_field, c_check and class_descriptors from this file

brief_check.class_S_fp32_pool6_word_at_a_new_bit: 0x3eaaaaab (1/3, pool 6's base word) at bit 22, beside pool 6's bits 12 and 20

corrected_before_commit.by: Q140(b)'s fix pass, after the pool's independent verification (verdict: holds with fixes); like the designer it never read M9, Q140(l)'s part, their scratch or their data directories

changes.K1: int8.bheld_7f replaced by int8.bheld_fd (B every byte 0xFD: seven bits set, two radix-4 digits, the same cell); bheld_7f's rule was E103's int8.i_afull_b127, measured on aifoundry1 card 1 and a training row of M8
changes.K2: fp16's C under the card's plain sum (E36 LAT-S1; blind5/ and blind6/CORRECTIONS.md C1); two fp16 real tiles hold half-zero words, and their C descriptors and c_op1_sha256 change
changes.K3: the launch-end C descriptor as blind6/CORRECTIONS.md C2: the mean over 32 ops from each of 8 starting counts, none a power of two, not one op from exactly 2^19 or 2^20
changes.K4: --check checks the files SHA256SUMS lists and the files it builds, so files beside the pool (predictions, notes) no longer fail it; SHA256SUMS covers the pool's own files only (blind6/CORRECTIONS.md C3)
changes.K5: int8.b_line_zero_55 promoted to priority 1, so priority 1 holds six strict L tiles beside the 6-bit control
changes.K6: wording: the rules of int8.b_line_7f_80_aconst and int8.real_qwen_l3_w8a8_down_massive, and the README
